method: Each parameter was set at normalized 0, 1 and 0.25 using VST3 controller values and IAudioProcessor parameter queues after restoring initialized state. Stored field samples were read from IComponent::getState and agreed with IEditController::normalizedParamToPlain at each point. Compiled bounds use the intersection across all recorded variants. No ranges are inferred from observed factory presets.
